lines.text: In 1932, Australia officially declared war on emus.
See, twenty thousand emus invaded wheat farms in Western Australia,
so the government sent soldiers with machine guns.
The plan: shoot them all in one week.
Day two: the emus ran into the bush in tiny groups,
Soldiers fired two thousand five hundred rounds
and killed fewer than fifty birds.
The commanding major said the emus could withstand an entire army division.
Parliament recalled the troops in humiliation.
Australia tried again the next year.
